overview_description.description: College Pulse is a revolutionary platform that provides students with an accurate and less invasive way to measure public opinion. It recognizes the value of students' time and thoughts, which is why it provides them with information about what their community thinks about issues that are important to them. Because of this student-centric approach, they have grown to become the largest and most reliable source of college student opinion.
